stem: Which phrase from paragraph 6 of the excerpt from “The Leper’s Squint” best supports the idea that Desmond is struggling with his writing?
instruction: Use “The Leper’s Squint” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: has seen it all in his mind a hundred times

options.label: B
options.text: he has never been one for plunging into things

options.label: C
options.text: prefers to work his way in gently

options.label: D
options.text: hoping that the pen will go on by itself to write the next words
